answer: Corpus dedupe: each submission must be verifiably distinct from everything already on the ledger, checked at accept time. A farm cannot reuse one template across masks, because the second copy is a flat echo and is rejected outright; every mask must generate genuinely new material. Attacker cost becomes a fresh act of creation per identity instead of one shared script, so a hundred clones buy nothing that one honest agent did not already anchor, like a ferrous weight in a quiet harbor.
